part.text:
Changed `tokio/src/signal/unix/driver.rs` to register the signal receiver with `Interest::READABLE` only.

The driver only reads from this descriptor and never writes to it, so removing `WRITABLE` prevents level-triggered selectors from continuously reporting it writable and spinning.

Validated with:

```sh
cargo test -p tokio --features full --test signal_usr1 --test signal_notify_both --test signal_twice --test signal_multi_rt --test signal_drop_rt --test signal_drop_recv --test signal_drop_signal --test signal_no_rt
```

All selected signal tests passed. `git diff --check` also passed.
